meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: The binding ultrawork-mode directive. This file IS the directive; read it only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让助手切换到高强度工作模式,长时间专注推进复杂任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望助手在难题上投入更多精力、持续而不半途而废
copy.tagline_en: Switch your assistant into a high-intensity mode to push through complex tasks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want the assistant to invest more effort and keep going on tough tasks

howto.what: 开启后 Claude 进入 ultrawork 编码模式,首行固定显示 ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!,先登记目标与成功标准、开持久记事本、列待办,再用真实渠道(浏览器、终端等)抓证据。
howto.when: 当你在对话中要求进入 ultrawork 模式、且该指令尚未出现在当前对话里时触发;接管后必须先在开工前完成技能调研、目标登记、记事本与待办四项准备。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式做这个任务,先登记目标和成功标准
say.note: 开工前会先登记目标与验收标准

say.text: 开启 ultrawork,用浏览器真实页面截图作为验收证据
say.note: 它会用真实渠道抓取证据来验证

howto.what_en: With ultrawork on, Claude's first line is 'ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!', then it registers a goal with success criteria, keeps a durable notepad and todo list, and proves work with evidence from a real surface (HTTP, browser, terminal).
howto.when_en: Read when you request ultrawork mode and the directive is not already in the conversation; bootstrap then requires a skill survey, goal registration, a notepad, and a todo list before other work.

say_en.note: First line becomes ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!

say_en.text: Run this task in ultrawork mode and register the goal first
say_en.note: It registers the goal and criteria first

say_en.text: Enable ultrawork and prove it with a real browser screenshot
say_en.note: It captures evidence to verify the work
